content: Rey-Salomón, Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-oguega, degi, reyneg-oguega, birga-dulagwen (20) gagasad.
A-sorbali, Salomón, Hiram-ega-neggweburmar-uksadi nudaksad. Geb agi Israel-dulemar-oambikusad.
Geb degine, Salomón, Hamat-neggwebur, Soba-yargi-siid, a-ebo bila-onosgua, Hamat-neggwebur-susa gusad.
Salomón, Tadmor-neggwebur nega-dulesulidganba-siid sobsad. Degi, bela Hamat-neggweburmargi mas-sabolemalad-neg sobsabalid.
Deyopira, neggweburmar-gandikmalad Bet-Horón-Nakwaled, degi, Bet-Horón-Dealed gannar sobsabalid, degi, e-galu-matusulid, e-yawagakmar obinosbalid, degi, yawagakmar-idu-suar-biir-megmalad obinosbalid.

Deginbali, Salomón, Baalat-neggwebur, degine, e-gingi-sabolemalad-negmar sobsabalid. E-ur-napagined-osabomalad-negmar sobsabalid, e-moli-ambikued-negmar sobsabalid. Degi, Salomón baigan-negmar e-itolegedba sobsabalid: Jerusalénʼgi, Líbano-yargi, degine, bela e-negdakmaid-ugakagi negmar-sobsa-naed.
Ar Israel-dulemar bela amar-obelossurmarsoggu, wemardi, we-yargi e-sergan-sorba besmalad. Salomón a-dulemarga we-garda-narmaklenaidse gandik-arbaleged-igar mesisad.

content.text: Deginbali, Salomón, ega-arbamalad-dakega e-dummagan dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe (250) nikabalid.

content: Salomón, Faraón-sisgwa David-neggweburgi-maidgi sesad, bia ega reyneg-sobsadse. Ar ade, Salomón binsaed: “Bab-Jehová-e-Ulu Rey-David-neggi-signonisoggu, reyneg neg-swilidikidga gunonisunnad. Degisoggu, an-ome we-neggi geg gudii gued.”
Degidgi, Salomón neg-ubeb-naid-asabin, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar uksasunnad. We-ailade, Salomón, Bab-Jehováʼga sobsa gusad.

content.text: birgagi irbaa iba-dummagan-onolegedgi ibmar ogumakar ukdaed.

content: Deginbali, Salomón e-bab-David-igar-mesisadbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga igar mesisad, adi, e-iba-arbamaladgi na muchub-muchub arbamalagar. Degi, Levita-dulemardi Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega urbilesmogad, adi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladbogwa bane-bane igar-megisadba arbamalagar. Ar David Bab-Dummadga-arbaedi, deyob igar mesisad. Degi, yawagak-dakmaladga yawagak-iliba e-igar-maidba ega mesisbalid.
Weyobi, Salomón Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-e-sailagan-mesialid-akale, bela-ogusadsega, bela ibmar-imaksad. Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg bela weyob ogulenonisunnad.
Degidgine, Salomón, Edom-yargi, demar-gaka naidsik, Ezión-Geber-neg-nugadse, degi, Elot-neg-nugadse naded.

Hiram, Salomónʼga e-gapdanmarba ur-dummagan barmisad. Degi, Hiram-e-gapdanmar, degi, e-selamar demargi nerguarmaladid. Amar, Ofirʼye-neg-nugadse Salomón-sordamarbo nadmalad. Agi, or nibir-milidulagwen-gakambe-gakapaa (33,000) Rey-Salomónʼse senonimalad.
